column1: # FR-503 numeric formats: DD/MM/YY, DD-MM-YYYY, DD.MM.YY. Clock: 2026-08-25T09:00 (Tue).
# Year-first dates. Added 3 Sep 2026, after the day-first pattern was found matching the
# trailing `10-14` of `2027-10-14`, finding no year on it, and filling in the current one —
# so a renewal due in October 2027 resolved to October 2026 with no warning. Inventing a year
# while a correct one sits in the text is worse than declining to read the format at all.
# The same shape with an impossible date is refused outright rather than half-matched into
# something plausible: without the withheld span, `13-45` would have been offered on its own.
# A dot is deliberately not a year-first separator: this is as likely to be a version number,
# and a build note becoming a calendar entry is the worse failure.
